brief:
An Israeli airstrike damaged a bus belonging to Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in Gaza City and wounded a staff member, Middle East Eye reported.

The strike hit the vehicle used by the humanitarian organization, which provides medical services across Gaza. No further details were immediately available about the circumstances of the airstrike or the condition of the wounded staff member.
dek: Israeli air strike wounds MSF staff, damages vehicle An Israeli air strike damaged a bus belonging to Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in Gaza City, resulting in the wounding staff member.
title: Israeli airstrike wounds Médecins Sans Frontières staff in Gaza City
